key_insight: A Quantum Transformer BSDE solver using multi-layer fully-connected variational quantum circuits and causal self-attention improves learning of high-dimensional BSDE trajectories by combining quantum parameterized embeddings with transformer-style sequence modeling.
engineering_relevance: This approach targets efficient solution of high-dimensional parabolic PDEs and stochastic control problems that arise in engineering, physics, and finance.
method: Represents normalized state trajectories as time-coordinate tokens.
Uses causal self-attention to model adapted gradient-process interactions in the BSDE formulation.
Places all trainable parameters in FC-VQC embedding, projection, feed-forward, and decoder modules while keeping attention operations classical and parameter-free.
evidence_signal: On three d=36 PDE benchmarks, QTransformer outperformed the non-attentive FC-VQC baseline and the classical Transformer at compact hidden widths, though the wider classical Transformer achieved the best overall accuracy.
watch_item: Performance gains depend on model width and benchmark setting, so the quantum advantage is not universal and the added quantum circuit complexity may affect practicality.
paper_title: Quantum Transformer BSDE Solver via Multi-Layer Fully-Connected Variational Quantum Circuits
